name: SEA (Segmentation Ensemble Attack, Croce, Singh and Hein, 2023)
description: Auto-PGD run once per loss in {masked CE, class-balanced masked CE, Jensen-Shannon}, keeping per case and per epsilon the candidate with the lowest foreground Dice. Costs three times the gradient evaluations of a single-loss arm. The 300-iteration red-eps schedule is not used at this budget.
